issue.title: Stabilize artifacts_stitches_persistent_filter_80x24 PNG snapshot
issue.description: The artifacts_stitches_persistent_filter_80x24 visual golden has failed intermittently in Full CI with an identical 146865-pixel diff. The pattern is bimodal and order-dependent under xdist, first red in CI run 33757602516 on 2026-09-03 and most recently red in 34907572118 on 2026-09-14; the 2026-09-14 rebaseline did not cover this node, so it can re-redden Full CI at any scheduled tick.

task_type_fields.evidence: Full CI saw an identical 146865-pixel diff in the artifacts_stitches_persistent_filter_80x24 PNG snapshot; the failure is bimodal and order-dependent under xdist, with first red run 33757602516 on 2026-09-03 and latest known red run 34907572118 on 2026-09-14. The related Sep 14 rebaseline did not regenerate this golden.
